basic_info.description: Designed by award-winning architect Stanley Saitowitz, this three-level Dogpatch live/work loft condo (3rd St at Mariposa) blends style, function, and modern design in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods. The top floor, 2-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,358 sq ft of flexible, open living space. Soaring barrel ceilings and a spiral staircase connect to the upper bedroom loft, while two private balconies extend your living space outdoors. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances and generous workspace. Hardwood floors, radiant heating, in-unit laundry, recessed lighting, walk-in closet, and updated finishes add everyday comfort. Offers garage parking (EV-compatible) with secure building access and extra storage. With Muni light rail at your doorstep, Caltrain nearby, and quick access to UCSF Mission Bay, Chase Center, and Oracle Park, this location is ideal for commuting and enjoying city amenities. A true Walker's Paradise (Walk Score 92, Bike Score 95), surrounded by parks, shops, and dining in Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, and Mission Bay.
